snippet.title: Timberholt -  A Free Horror Game
snippet.description:
Play Now: 
https://roawrvideostore.itch.io/timberholt

Help Amber record the crackle of a campfire for her ASMR channel, explore the ruins of Timberholt castle (now owned by Camping Grounds Services), solve puzzles, learn to fire shotgun and swing a sword, face the ancient evil and lift the curse... or run, hide and die!
